During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] staged an '''ambush''' on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy in the [[Laramus system/Legends|Laramus system]]. Acting on information obtained by [[Spy/Legends|spies]], the Alliance [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Visseon II]]'' decanted from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the Laramus system to attack a well-armed Imperial convoy. The Imperial convoy accelerated to escape [[Laramus]]' [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]], splitting in two to force the ''Visseon II'' to choose a target. Once the cruiser committed to the pursuit, the Imperial force split again, once more forcing the ''Visseon II'' to select a target to chase. Once the cruiser had committed again, the remaining Imperial [[Transport/Legends|transports]] regrouped to escape, while the Imperial escort vessels converged on the ''Visseon II'', sure that the Rebel [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was easy prey.<ref name="Laramus" />

With the escort ships engaged in their pursuit of the ''Visseon II'', a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-6 X-wing starfighters]], accompanied by several [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], emerged from hyperspace in front of the Imperial transports. The X-wings promptly destroyed on transport and ordered the others to shut down their [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and prepare to be boarded. The shuttles delivered [[Commando/Legends|commandoes]] to the transports, capturing them and their contents.<ref name="Laramus" />

The escort vessels, trading shots with the ''Visseon II'', eventually realized what was happening to the convoy and broke off their attack on the cruiser to assist. The X-wings delayed the Imperial escorts long enough for the transports to jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]]. With no transports to protect, the Imperial escorts disengaged and fled. The Alliance captured fourteen transports with no losses.<ref name="Laramus" />
